name: The Exes Playbook
source:
Senior year was supposed to be your fresh start. You’ve got a cheer squad to lead, a dream career to chase, and every intention of getting over Peyton - the football star who ended your seven-year relationship. There’s just one small problem: you signed a lease together, and neither of you is moving out.

Making your ex miserable seems like a solid game plan…until a scout with the power to change your future assumes you’re still the perfect couple. Now you need Peyton to play along, even as petty payback and familiar touches make it harder to remember which feelings you’re supposed to be faking.

[From [url=https://mailchi.mp/pixelberrystudios/choicesinsidersoct26?e=7d990d0ca3]Choices Insiders[/url]]
translation:
毕业学年本该是你崭新的开始。你既要带领啦啦队，又要追逐梦想中的事业，还一心打算彻底放下佩顿——那个主动结束你们七年恋情的橄榄球明星。只不过眼下有个小麻烦：你们当初一起签了租房合同，而且谁也不肯搬走。

让前任不好过原本是个相当稳妥的计划……直到一位足以改变你前途的星探误以为你们仍是那对模范情侣。如今你不得不拜托佩顿陪你演戏，哪怕幼稚的报复与熟悉的触碰，正让你越来越难分清究竟哪些感情才是装出来的。
